recommendation_summary: The reply recommends wrapping nightly-sync so cron always sends an email on success or failure, including startup crashes.

labels.Requirements and who asked: Notice when nightly-sync fails without reading logs, asked by you after 4 silent token failures.
labels.Deleted: Central log on Synology and Dockerizing everything.
labels.Bottleneck: No alert when the job never reaches the email step, not missing logs.
labels.Checked myself: cron on edna at 03:00, email only on success, no other alerts, and you stated you will not read logs.

note: The reply recommends one failure-email wrapper and rejects the Synology/Docker stack, but a wrapper can't alert if cron never runs the job at all.
